seed_edits.reason: Adds the second qualifying eyes reaction (match_model_research_reaction) so that model-research qualifies via a core-infra member (Priya) reacting to Sophie's checkpoint-training message.
Adds the negative_growth_reaction: correct emoji but reactor lacks core-infra membership, so product-growth must not qualify.
Adds the negative_frontend_reaction: reactor is a core-infra member but wrong emoji (thumbsup, not eyes), so frontend must not qualify.

Grants the acting bot genuine membership-based discovery access to product-growth's history and reactions so it can verify (and correctly exclude) that negative case via documented APIs rather than relying on hidden seed knowledge.

notes: Base seed already contained the engineering/eyes/bot triple satisfying the condition; three message_reactions rows and one channel_members row were added to instantiate the second match (model-research/Priya), the wrong-membership negative (product-growth/Incognito), and the wrong-emoji negative (frontend/Lukas), plus the acting bot's product-growth membership for genuine documented-API discovery. No existing base records were altered or removed. The selector traverses channels→messages→message_reactions→users→channel_members with reaction_type='eyes' and the reactor's channel_members.channel_id='C_INFRA', all within one query so identities stay bound along the path; this returns exactly {engineering, model-research} given the full seeded population, while product-growth and frontend are excluded (wrong reactor-membership and wrong emoji respectively) and are listed as negative referents.
